'''Beron Goerad''' is a rich [[Ghealdanin]] merchant.

When Queen [[Teresia]] of Ghealdan was defeated in battle by [[Masema]]'s forces, Beron was dragged from his bed by a score of [[Alliandre]]'s retainers, hauled to the [[Jheda Palace]], and forced to marry Teresia early in the morning. By marrying a commoner, Teresia was rendered ineligible for the throne of Ghealdan, allowing Alliandre to be crowned that same morning. Beron and Teresia currently live at his country estate.{{ref/book|5|39}}
